notes.v1_02: Witch Hat: Paint the hat in deep plum-purple felt with violet shadows instead of black, with a soft lighter sheen down the left of the cone. Make the green rings slightly softer and lighter, with no bright yellow-green core behind the brim.
notes.v1_04: Candlestick: Replace the grey speckled stone counter with a smooth warm honey-wood ledge. Let the flame cast a small warm glow on the candle top and the inside of the dish. Put the right side of the brass stem in clear shadow.
notes.v1_05: Cauldron: Paint the pot dark blue-violet iron with a lit rim and a broad soft highlight on the upper left of the belly instead of solid black, with no scratches. Remove the daisies. Make the pink rings an even, slightly dustier rose with no bright spot behind the pot.
notes.v1_09: Spooky Tree: Remove the falling orange leaf. Light from the upper left so the right side of the trunk is slightly darker, and add a soft tree shadow on the grass to the right.
notes.v1_01: Jack-o'-lantern: Shade the rib grooves and the right side of the pumpkin with deep red-brown, keeping a broad sheen on the left ribs. Make the purple sunburst slightly lighter and less saturated.
notes.v1_10: Ghost Sheep: Remove the jack-o'-lantern and the motion lines; the sheep stands alone on the lawn. Make the sky a calm daytime blue with only a hint of lavender. Shade the sheet folds in soft blue-grey, slightly lighter.
notes.v1_03: Bat: Change the sunburst to cool violet-purple rays. Paint the wing membranes dusky violet-brown and draw the body fur as a few soft rounded clumps instead of strands.
notes.v1_06: Candy Corn: Light from the upper right so the left side of the candy is clearly darker, matching its cast shadow. Make the tip a warm waxy cream. Darken the wall stripes slightly so the tip is the brightest spot.
notes.v1_08: Haunted House: Remove the moon and the daisies. Paint the stone walls a warm lilac and the roofs deep plum, with the side wall and the right of the tower slightly darker. Make the sky and grass slightly softer and less saturated.
